name: servicehealth-incident-correlation
description: Checks Personalized Service Health (PSH) events and resource-level impacts to determine whether a Google Cloud incident affects a project or its resources, returning an impact verdict with affected resources, published symptoms, and workarounds. Use when asked whether Google Cloud is having an outage or affecting a project or its resources, when looking up a PSH event, or when triaging live Google Cloud workload issues or alerts whose symptoms suggest a possible Google Cloud service disruption—even if the user does not suspect an outage. Don't use for local code or build errors, routine alerts or automations that neither ask for a service health check nor suggest a platform disruption, configuring PSH alerts, or checking non-project-specific public status.
